2911.title: Held model-picker press collapses a narrow composer
2911.rootCauseOneLine: The focus-loss frame collapses the composer before a held popover trigger can enter its open state.
2911.proposedFix: Keep the composer expanded during the pointer lifetime of a local overlay trigger, then clear that state after release.
2911.caveats: At 448 px, the collapse moved the trigger before release, so the picker did not open in the live run.
